meta.title: OpenVoxTuner - Real-time pitch correction & harmony generation for vocals
meta.description: OpenVoxTuner - Real-time pitch correction & harmony generation for vocals. VST3 / AU / Standalone - Open Source AGPLv3.

hero.subtitle: Real-time pitch correction & harmony generation for vocals. VST3 / AU / Standalone.

features.title: Everything you need
features.subtitle: Professional-grade pitch correction, harmony generation, and creative tools — all open source.

pitchCorrection.title: Pitch Correction
pitchCorrection.description: Auto Mode with scale-aware correction, adjustable speed/amount/character. Transparent or Modern style.

harmonyEngine.title: Harmony Engine
harmonyEngine.description: 21 harmony types: intervals, triads, vocal stacks. Voice mode (pitch-shifted live vocal) or Synth mode (6 tone colors).

formantPreservation.title: Formant Preservation
formantPreservation.description: Independent formant shift (+-5 semitones) with LPC cross-synthesis for natural-sounding transposition.

keyDetection.title: Key Detection
keyDetection.description: Detect musical key via the companion app OpenVoxKey (runs alongside your DAW) or directly from a sidechain input. Automatic scale quantization.

realTimeVisualizer.title: Real-time Visualizer
realTimeVisualizer.description: Live pitch display with input/output/harmony traces, piano keyboard, cents meter, waveform overlay.

curveEditor.title: Curve Editor
curveEditor.description: Melodyne-style graphical editing: add/move points, snap to scale/grid, copy/paste, undo/redo.

midiOut.title: MIDI OUT
midiOut.description: Use the plugin as a MIDI source in your DAW. The tuned voice and 4 harmony voices each output on their own MIDI channel for driving virtual instruments.

multiLanguage.title: Multi-language
multiLanguage.description: Interface available in 6 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Chinese.

effectsSuite.title: Effects Suite
effectsSuite.description: Built-in Gate, Compressor, Reverb, and Formant processing. Complete vocal chain in one plugin.

showcase.title: See it in
showcase.subtitle: A professional vocal production tool with an intuitive, dark-themed interface.

slides.title: Real-time Pitch Visualization
slides.description: Live pitch display with input/output/harmony traces, cents meter, and waveform overlay. See every correction happen in real time.

slides.title: 21 Harmony Types
slides.description: From simple thirds to vocal stacks and power chords. Voice mode uses pitch-shifted live vocals, Synth mode offers 6 tone colors.

slides.title: Melodyne-style Curve Editor
slides.description: Graphical pitch editing with click-to-add points, snap to scale/grid, copy/paste, undo/redo. Full creative control.

slides.title: Piano Roll View
slides.description: Switch between curve and piano roll editing. See harmony voice distribution across the keyboard with clear note blocks.
